description: Readonly substitution relationships. One row per (target, substitute) ordered pair; add both directions when the transfer is mutual. relationship_direction is +1 when pressure on the substitute pushes demand ONTO the target, -1 when it pulls demand away. transfer_rate is the share of the substitute's reconstructed daily demand that moves at full pressure; max_transfer_ratio caps the transfer as a share of the target's own daily demand.
